text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Warm and cool colours, and how brands use them
Warm (red, orange, yellow): energy, urgency, attention
Cool (blue, green, purple): calm, trust, professionalism
Associations, not laws: they shift with culture and context. Treat them as hypotheses about your audience.
